L01.drivers: Profile shows a deep, rounded barrel ribcage bulging both forward and back over a pinched waist, with a slight forward lean of the upper trunk; front shows narrow sloping shoulders, thin long limbs and slightly forward knees. Body proportions are not explained by fat or muscle.
limb_cues: slender legs with knee slightly forward in profile

structure.axial_section_shape: deep ovoid thorax over a narrow waist; thorax deeper than wide
structure.joint_integration: narrow shoulders set low on rounded thorax; slim knee and ankle transitions
structure.segment_relations: large thorax relative to slender limbs; long arms
structure.load_path: weight carried from a forward-set thorax down through a narrow waist to slightly flexed legs

non_structural_factors.notes: slight forward lean; mainly the thorax shape

L02.drivers: Typical adult male proportions with a mild soft belly and buttocks.

structure.axial_section_shape: ordinary oval trunk, slightly soft abdomen
structure.load_path: vertical through pelvis to straight legs

L04.drivers: Slim, ordinary male build, nearly identical to L03.

L05.drivers: Ordinary build with a mild belly and fuller buttocks.

structure.axial_section_shape: ordinary trunk with a soft abdomen

L06.drivers: Ordinary male, slightly broader shoulders and thighs.

L07.drivers: Same pattern as L01: a deep, bulging barrel thorax front and back in profile over a narrow waist, with thin limbs and slightly flexed knees; the front view shows a wide upper rib cage and narrow shoulders.

structure.axial_section_shape: deep ovoid thorax over a narrow waist
structure.joint_integration: low narrow shoulders on rounded thorax; slim joints
structure.load_path: forward-set thorax over narrow waist to slightly flexed legs

L09.drivers: Slim, ordinary build with long straight legs.

L10.drivers: Very wide, blocky trunk with high, massive shoulders; long heavy arms with oversized fists hanging to mid-thigh; short, thick, knock-kneed legs with very large broad feet; the profile shows flexed knees and a forward-thrust lower leg.
limb_cues: long heavy arms with large hands

structure.axial_section_shape: wide, deep, boxy torso tapering only slightly to a broad pelvis
structure.joint_integration: bulky, knotted joints; shoulders merge into trunk mass; heavy knees and ankles
structure.segment_relations: short legs, long arms, oversized hands and feet relative to body height
structure.load_path: heavy trunk through broad pelvis into short, bent, splayed legs onto large planted feet

non_structural_factors.notes: bulk and muscle add to the read, but proportions and feet carry it

L12.drivers: Same body type as L10: a very broad, boxy trunk, huge shoulders, long arms with big fists, short heavy flexed legs and very large feet; slightly wider and more muscular than L10.

structure.axial_section_shape: wide, deep, boxy torso over a broad pelvis
structure.joint_integration: bulky, knotted joints; heavy knees and ankles
structure.segment_relations: short legs, long arms, oversized hands and feet
structure.load_path: heavy trunk through broad pelvis into short, bent legs onto large feet

non_structural_factors.notes: as with L10, with more mass

groups.label: massive boxy trunk, short bent legs, long arms, huge hands and feet

distinguishing_features: L01/L07 keep near-human limb lengths and slenderness, but each has a deep, rounded thorax that bulges front and back above a pinched waist. L10/L12 are massive, with a boxy trunk, short flexed legs, long arms, and oversized hands and feet. The two groups differ in mass, segment ratios and where the anatomy is unusual (the thorax only versus the whole body plan).
